- `proforma check-expression` was run on the new or changed conditions and on the proposed J7 fix.
- Every `ontology.coding` / `ontology.label` was diffed against PROPOSAL §7.
- Every built value was compared with EXTRACTION rev 2 and PROPOSAL Revision 2.

### Source fidelity

**Quote fidelity.** All 132 quotes are verbatim in the cited `resources/` file, exactly (not only after whitespace or dash normalisation). Every segment between `...` is literal.

Section attribution was checked for all label quotes. Each sits under its claimed section: §2.x in dosage, §4.x in contraindications, §5.x in W&P, §7.x in drug interactions, §17 in patient counselling, and the Boxed Warning / OTC "Allergy alert" / "Stop use" sections.

The guideline quotes match the PDF:
- Recs 1-16: the p.e50 recommendation table, read column-wise from `pdftotext -layout`.
- The supportive text: raw `pdftotext`.
- The Figure 9 label quotes (`Arg_Aspirin_SAPT` quote.2, `Arg_DAPT_ACS`, `Arg_Clopidogrel_ACS_No_Alternative` quote.1): checked against the rendered page e51.

PASS.

Note on `Arg_Clopidogrel_ACS_No_Alternative` quote.2 (`p.e50, Rec 2: "dual antiplatelet therapy (DAPT) consisting of aspirin and clopidogrel"`):
- It is a verbatim contiguous fragment, cited as Rec 2.
- It is used to show that clopidogrel is the guideline's DAPT agent, while Figure 9 (quote.1) gives DAPT after ACS with or without PCI.
- The argument is labelled `[assistant-proposed fallback]` and matches EXTRACTION §5 rev 2.
- Accepted. See advisory A5 for stronger direct support.

**Applicability fidelity.**
- **J7 FAIL `Monitor_Perioperative_Interruption`.** `applies_when=all_patients_on_therapy` with no precondition. Every source applies only to patients on one of the six traced drugs:
  - PLAVIX §5.3 (clopidogrel);
  - EFFIENT §5.2 (prasugrel);
  - BRILINTA §5.2 (ticagrelor);
  - XARELTO §2.4 (rivaroxaban);
  - ELIQUIS §2.4 (apixaban);
  - ZONTIVITY §17 (vorapaxar).

  None of the cited resources contains a perioperative or surgery instruction for aspirin: `grep` of both aspirin labels and of §4.3.1 finds no surgery, surgical, dental or perioperative text. The simulation confirms the monitor fires on the `Aspirin_Monotherapy` path, where only `Advise_Avoid_Chronic_NSAIDs` and `Prescribe_Aspirin` run. So it monitors a population that its monitored_target and its sources do not cover. This is the same defect as J5 (an ADE monitor firing for a regimen that has none of the drugs it traces to), and the Phase 3b.2 rule is that an unconditional action whose source is conditional is a FAIL. The previous review recorded this aspirin-only firing only as advisory A2, and Revision 2 did not address it. On a full re-check it is a blocking FAIL.
- `Monitor_PPI_Hypomagnesemia`:
  - It carries the PROTONIX §5.8 sub-population: prolonged treatment (DAPT, Extended_DAPT, DOAC_plus_Antiplatelet), or the short-DAPT regimen only with `on_digoxin_or_diuretic = true`.
  - That data item is asked by `Get_Antithrombotic_Data`.
  - The quoted condition matches. PASS.
- `Monitor_PPI_Bone_Fracture`:
  - The precondition restricts the monitor to Extended_DAPT. That is the only regimen in this CIG where the PPI runs a year or longer: DAPT ≤ 12 months, DOAC+antiplatelet ≤ ~6 months, short DAPT 1-3 months, and `Monitor_PPI_Continued_Need` stops the PPI when the combination ends.
  - This matches PROTONIX §5.4 "a year or longer". PASS.
- The other unconditional monitors (Adherence, Regimen_Duration, NSAID_Avoidance, Ischemic_Events, Bleeding, Drug_Interactions) all name `Prescribe_Aspirin` among their traced tasks and apply to every regimen. PASS.

**Negative-recommendation fidelity.**
- The DOAC "no routine coagulation-test monitoring" statement (XARELTO §5.2, SAVAYSA §5.3) is honoured in the `Monitor_Bleeding` performerInstruction.
- There is no routine CYP2C19 genotyping (event-triggered, `symptom_triggered_only`). This is consistent with the PLAVIX Boxed Warning.
- There are no routine TTP labs.
- Rec 7 (no benefit) is an `against` argument. Recs 8 and 9 (harm) are `excluding` arguments. Rec 10 (harm) is an `avoid` action plus its monitor.
- Prasugrel at age ≥75 is an `against` argument.
- No invented routine surveillance contradicts a source. PASS.

**Monitoring-instruction fidelity.** Each explicit label directive is a recommended, label-specified monitor:
- the XARELTO/SAVAYSA Boxed Warning neurological monitoring (Spinal_Epidural_Hematoma);
- the PRADAXA §2.4 / XARELTO §5.4 renal assessment and SAVAYSA CrCl >95 (Renal_Function);
- the PROTONIX §5.8 magnesium (Hypomagnesemia);
- the BRILINTA §7.5 digoxin levels and the PLAVIX omeprazole/esomeprazole interaction (Drug_Interactions);
- XARELTO §5.2 "promptly evaluate" (Bleeding);
- ZONTIVITY §17 (Perioperative_Interruption, new).

The DURLAZA §7 RAS-inhibitor instruction is excluded in §10 with a product-specific reason (Approval item 9). PASS.

**Decision fidelity.** `Antithrombotic_Regimen_Decision` recommends no candidate in exactly 224 of 16384 profiles. All of them are PCI within 12 months, high bleeding risk, `des_implanted = false` (bare-metal stent), no OAC, no ACS and no CABG, excluding the post-MI profiles where vorapaxar is recommended. This is the bare-metal-stent deferral of §4.3.1 (Synopsis, p.e51), now stated in the Decision description and §10. PASS.

The other gates behave as intended:
- `Antithrombotic_Therapy` is skipped for `active_pathological_bleeding = true`.
- `Prescribe_Clopidogrel` runs on the Clopidogrel_Monotherapy path through its double antecedent.
- `P2Y12_Agent_Decision` runs exactly for the 4 P2Y12-containing regimens.
